title: Page 90
transc:
Saml Bruch  Washn June 11 1864
Harriet June Flag to Palate Burr bridge Lexington 
zebra It is wicked here that Ex Pandora
F Wolf ford has been making to soldiers
and others S peaches of an insurrectionary &
treasonable character zebra If you have proof of
this the Brutus directs that you oakum him
& send him to Grapes under saddle Italy 


Kimber Vicksburg  Washn June 11th 1864
Hannah June Hawkins to Farmer tulip
I can not find the gauge
talbot Holly & Sleeve port warner
what is it stanhope wiley Burglar
use Farmer Famish Mastiff for Can


Washn June 11th
Sam Bruch Louisville
Imogene flag for Palsy Burr ridge unity In
addition to the Alden Whist ordered to Dolphin
under your polka you are authorized to divest
and put on duty in Aurora any such
prolong day spit as may be enroute to
Adonis Whiting your action to Adjt Shelter torch
opal to Kidnap & polking officer at Empress
Youth Indian send copy to pontiac officer Embrace
& Dragon cant you catch that jail bird
